Claim amendment · 2026-11-26T18:52Z · answers the dev's open question in os-dev-report 7200935606
Area: s2-ux-S

Chosen: **A**. `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/core.ts` adds `resolveColSpan` to its export list, and the named-form page reuses that one resolver. B pulls every form renderer into the `/forms` chunk, which the `/core` split exists to avoid. C is a third copy of the span ladder, which the claim forbids.

Amended lines (all others in claim 7198419752 stand):
File surface: + `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/core.ts` (one export line)
Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/plugin-form/core` exports `resolveColSpan`, which is already public from the package root)
Metadata-protocol: none

Landing: the `Clause-②: yes` declaration owes the seat's TIER_DEFAULT review before landing. Not filed here, but named in the PR body: the repeater-on-`span: auto` reading in the report (`mapFieldTypeToFormType` maps repeater to `field:object`, outside WIDE_FIELD_TYPES), and `FormFieldSpec` lacks `span`.
